text:
jessica_ml: Heads-up — new partner request to onboard `orchid-xl-70b` for summarization + assistant flows. Can we triage this week? I'm proposing a lightweight scoring rubric to decide priority: Quality (40), Latency (20), Cost (20), Stability/Risk (10), Roadmap fit (10). Thoughts?

roshan_research: +1 to the rubric. Recommend we add a small bias/regression checklist under Quality: toxic-rate delta, instruction-following regressions, and hallucination spot-checks. Also suggest we require a 1k-example eval run for initial score.

marta_prod: This could unlock a new "smart summaries" feature for Q3 if latency stays < 600ms p95 for 2048 tokens. Roadmap note: if we push this, we need a canary env by mid-July. tagging @dan_engineer to estimate infra work. :calendar:

dan_engineer: I can do the canary work. For onboarding smoke tests, here's what I ran locally against the small variant: 
```bash
# quick generate smoke test
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' \
  -d '{"model":"orchid-xl-70b","input":"Summarize: The quarterly results...","max_tokens":128}'
```
Initial numbers (dev GPU, batch=1, seq=512): p95 ~ 540ms, cost estimate ~0.9x our atlas baseline. Perplexity on wikitext sample: 16.4. Ran quick safety filter: toxic-rate ~0.6% (need deeper review).

jessica_ml: Nice — can we capture those numbers in the intake doc? Also, assign weights -> we might bump Roadmap fit to 15 and Cost down to 15 since product impact is high.

roshan_research: Agreed on bumping roadmap. For quant experiments, let's try 4-bit q8_0 and q4f16 on a single shard to see quality delta. I'll own the quant smoke: baseline vs q4f16. Expect a small perf upside; we'll watch instruction-following metrics.

marta_prod: Who can prepare the 1k eval set? We need: 300 instruction-following, 300 summarization, 200 chit-chat, 200 safety/bias prompts. I can pull product examples and label buckets.

dan_engineer: I'll set up the canary namespace + routing policy. Suggest we route 5% of internal traffic first, with automatic fallback to atlas-70b if latency > 700ms or error rate > 1%. Policy draft:
```yaml
canary_percent: 5
fallback: atlas-70b
latency_slo_ms: 700
error_rate_threshold: 0.01
```

ashley_sre: FYI capacity-wise, dedicated p3d slots are limited in our staging region. Recommend we test on g5dn as a proxy for initial perf, then a small run on p4d for realistic p95. Also add rate limits per token during canary: 200 requests/min per org.

ci-bot: Automated smoke results ready: 1938254725 — unit tests: pass, lint: pass, smoke-gen p95 560ms, sample perplexity 16.6, safety-check failures 3/500 (0.6%). Full report: https://ci.internal/reports/1938254725

jessica_ml: Good. Next steps: (1) roshan -> run q4f16 vs baseline and push eval artifact; (2) marta -> assemble 1k eval set; (3) dan -> canary infra + routing policy; (4) ashley -> confirm staging capacity and rate limits. Meet Thurs 10am PT to decide prioritization score and whether to slot into roadmap. Add any blockers here. :pushpin:
